result.description: Web platform for building, deploying and scaling web apps with serverless functions, edge logic and continuous deployment.
result.auth_detail: OAuth2 (auth-code, client id/secret) required for public integrations; personal access tokens (Bearer) for own account/team use.
result.access_detail: Free plan exists on pricing page, credit-based, no sales gate. Anyone can sign up, create personal access tokens and register OAuth apps in the UI.
result.api_notes: Netlify REST API (OpenAPI spec) covers sites, deploys, builds, env vars, DNS, forms, functions, hooks, teams/accounts, members, etc. Plus CLI and JS client.

evidence.quote: If you’re making a public integration with Netlify for others to enjoy, you must use OAuth2.
Connect to the Netlify MCP server to equip your agent with the best of Netlify expertise and the Netlify CLI.
